narrative.overview: Every leave request is a mission with waypoints: you → 林主管 → 王經理. v3 borrows SpaceX's web language (black ground, white type, tracked capitals, square edges, hairline rules) as an idiom only, so the one thing in motion, a request moving toward approval, is the only thing lit.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground, rules instead of cards.
White is the only accent; color only as request state.
Square corners; outlined buttons whose fill rises on hover; solid white primary.
Huge numerals over tracked small labels.
Top bar chrome and full-height right panels.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: White is the accent. No second accent; state colors mean state only.

rules.name: The Hours Are Words Rule
rules.body: Quantities always carry their unit in plain words.

dos: Do separate content with rules and space, not boxes.
Do use tracked caps for labels and huge numerals for hours.
Do keep body text ≥16px and controls ≥44px tall.
Do show the journey wherever a request appears.
donts: Don't use SpaceX's name, logo, typeface files or photography.
Don't round a corner or add a drop shadow.
Don't add a second accent color.
